entry.title: CPI for all items increases 0.6% in September; gasoline rises
entry.content: In September, the Consumer Price Index rose 0.6 percent, seasonally adjusted. The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent. Over the last 12 months the index rose 3.7 percent.

entry.title: CPI for all items increases 0.4% in August; shelter rises
entry.content: In August, the Consumer Price Index rose 0.4 percent.
